draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.80, the 207th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 19th of 22 at LB. He went 170th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (207th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing standouts: 20-yard shuttle (94th percentile), three-cone (88th percentile). College production: 90 tackles in 2020, 6th of 22 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the San Francisco 49ers. 46 career games and 5 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 2 in 2021. Weak spots: combined tackles 9 (13th percentile), approximate value 1 (14th percentile). Played 11 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-5 off-ball linebacker who played: 9 combined tackles against a median of 66, below the norm.
